caution_findings.evidence_context: Current paper identifies AMP2041, calls it cyclic, and states the supplier verified sequence/concentration by HPLC and mass spectroscopy, but exact sequence letters are absent from the current XML/PDF. Local database catalogs agree on HKCAKIKWRGVHVKYCA; this is preserved as database-supported, not primary-source sequence verification for this DOI.
